items.title: Boltzmann factor
items.sutra: घातांकः ळचखस्य घातेन ३ ऋणम् १ एकः घातांकः घातस्य २ कः टः ऋणम् १
items.declarations: प्रकरणम् एकः ळञख कः ळञख टः ळञख ।
items.gloss_en: the power, with exponent minus the product of E and the reciprocal of the product of k and T, of e
items.units: E and kT in the same energy unit; result dimensionless
items.meaning: Relative occupation of a state of energy E at temperature T.
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling

items.title: Planck spectral shape
items.sutra: घातः २ घातांकः क्षस्य ३ घातांकः सङ्कलनस्य २ ऋणम् १ घातांकः ळचखस्य क्षेण ऋणम् १
items.gloss_en: the cube of x divided by the sum of minus 1 and the power, with exponent x, of e
items.meaning: Shape of the Planck spectrum in the reduced variable x; peaks near x of about 2.82.
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling

items.title: Lorentz factor
items.sutra: घातांकः घातांकस्य सङ्कलनस्य २ १ घातः २ ऋणम् १ घातांकः वस्य २ १⁄२ ऋणम् १
items.gloss_en: the reciprocal of the square root of the sum of 1 and minus the square of v
items.meaning: Time dilation and length contraction factor; diverges as v approaches 1.
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling
items.oracle_note: Lorentz factor, v in units of c

items.title: Inverse-square force
items.sutra: घातः ४ कः ककः कककः घातांकः घातांकस्य रस्य २ ऋणम् १
items.declarations: प्रकरणम् कः ळञख ककः ळञख कककः ळञख रः ळञख ।
items.gloss_en: the product of k, q, Q and the reciprocal of the square of r
items.units: force = k q Q / r^2 in consistent units
items.meaning: Coulomb force (Newton gravity has the same form with a sign).
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling

items.title: Harmonic oscillator
items.sutra: घातः २ अककः ळघकः घाते २ तः ववः
items.declarations: प्रकरणम् अककः ळञख तः ळञख ववः ळञख ।
items.gloss_en: the product of A and the cosine of the product of t and w
items.units: A in length, w in 1/time, t in time
items.meaning: Displacement of an undamped oscillator started at its maximum.
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling

items.title: Gaussian envelope
items.sutra: घातांकः ळचखस्य घातेन ३ ऋणम् १ घातांकः क्षस्य २ घातांकः घातस्य २ २ घातांकः सस्य २ ऋणम् १
items.gloss_en: the power, with exponent minus the product of the square of x and the reciprocal of the product of 2 and the square of s, of e
items.units: x and s in the same length unit
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling
